CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates) and an explicit organization/access status (origin/current) are both present and separately evidenced for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation linkage to content organization/access is stated.

C.rationale: Identified content (red) with explicit coordinate attribute and explicit current time label.

D.rationale: The report separately states an origin/status token for the same identified content, distinguishing identity from organization/status.

O.rationale: The origin/represented_time fields indicate how the content is presented/represented (current/copied_prior_record) for that referent.
